full_details: At nine you told Garnish it was not a reading. You tried the street only as far as the first anger, read two lines of Mab yourself, and stopped Nick at the girl's entrance. He said she was careful, not shy, and you wrote it down. Kemp played a servant with a napkin and did not ask for a song. Burbage said the boy at the feast had read too many sonnets. Pope liked the old man better. You played in the afternoon, and that play is not kept here. After it, Margery brought the Guildhall news. Five are condemned. The charge is high treason, levying war. Nobody knows the day. You told John you go into Warwickshire on Monday, on the letter.
one_sentence: You tried the street, Mab and the feast on the men who will speak them, and heard that five were condemned for levying war.
title: The street and Mab tried, and five condemned
